name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for engineering, fueled by countless hours spent tinkering with engines in his youth. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he joined a small Portuguese racing team as a junior engineer. His dedication and sharp analytical skills quickly propelled him through the ranks. He worked his way up, eventually becoming a team lead before transitioning into a more strategic role.

His approach as a Sporting Director is rooted in data-driven decision-making, coupled with a keen understanding of team dynamics. Ricardo believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. He's known for his ability to identify and nurture young talent, always on the lookout for the next generation of motorsport stars. Ricardo joined Iron Dames with a clear vision: to build a championship-winning team by combining technical expertise, strategic planning, and a strong focus on team cohesion. His calm demeanor under pressure and his knack for problem-solving make him a valuable asset in the high-stakes world of motorsport.

What sets Ricardo apart is his unwavering commitment to innovation. He constantly seeks out new technologies and strategies to gain a competitive edge, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible. He is also known for his ability to mediate conflicts and foster a positive team environment, a skill that has been crucial to his success.
